description: This file defines the StreamInterface interface in the PSR HTTP Message package, specifying the contract for stream objects including methods for reading, writing, seeking, and retrieving metadata from data streams.

classes.name: StreamInterface
classes.description: An interface that describes a data stream with methods for common stream operations such as reading, writing, seeking, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Reads all data from the stream into a string, attempting to seek to the beginning before reading.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream and any underlying resources.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Separates underlying resources from the stream, making it unusable afterward.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream's read/write pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at the end.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Seeks to the beginning of the stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns remaining contents in the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata or specific entries within it.
